blocks.text:
After breakfast, enjoy a full-day excursion to the Pacific coast.

The road to Valparaíso and Viña del Mar passes through olive groves, orchards and vineyards in the Curacaví and Casablanca valleys, about 120 km from Santiago.

Built across 42 hills, Valparaíso is famous for its distinctive cityscape. Its historic quarter is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Historic funiculars, stairways and pedestrian paths connect the different levels.

Visit Sotomayor Square and the Maritime Directorate building, a national monument. Then walk up Cerro Concepción along the Gervasoni and Atkinson promenades, enjoying a view of the seaport, one of Valparaíso's defining landmarks.

Continue to Viña del Mar, the “Garden City”, where beaches meet rocky coastlines. See the Flower Clock, Reñaca Beach, the waterfront and the Fonck Museum.

Return to Santiago. The excursion lasts approximately nine hours in total. A lunch stop is planned en route; lunch is paid for separately.
